fusions.name: One Long Wait
fusions.desc: A lunge from stillness that deals 34 damage and is always a critical hit. It leaves the target [Pinned] for 3 seconds and 15% easier to wound for 6 seconds.

fusions.name: Roll It Under
fusions.desc: Rolls with the target held in your grip: a weapon strike that deals 18 damage and uses up every affliction you have on the target for 60% more damage each. It then leaves the target [Bleeding] for 3 damage a second for 4 seconds.

fusions.name: Sunk to the Eyes
fusions.desc: Veils you for 10 seconds: enemies notice you 70% later. Attacking ends it.

fusions.name: Stillness Before the Snap
fusions.desc: After 12 seconds without a critical hit, your critical chance rises by 35% for your next strike.
